# Three.js 0.183.0 (r183)

Unmodified selected files from the official npm package `three@0.183.0`:
https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.183.0.tgz

Source tag: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r183
License: MIT, retained in `LICENSE`.

Included: `build/three.core.js`, `build/three.module.js`, `OrbitControls`, `GLTFLoader`, and its `BufferGeometryUtils` / `SkeletonUtils` dependencies. The preview uses a local import map; no CDN or runtime network dependency. Files are vendored dependencies, not project-generated shaders; do not hand-edit them.
